thread.title: Apple (AAPL) Receives a Hold from Nomura

author: Brian Anderson
title: Apple (AAPL) Receives a Hold from Nomura
text:
Brian Anderson - January 30, 2019, 8:06 AM EDT SHARE ON:
Nomura analyst Jeff Kvaal maintained a Hold rating on Apple ( AAPL ) today and set a price target of $170 . yesterday at $154.68, close to its 52-week low of $142.
 Kvaal is a 4-star analyst with an average return of 9.0% and a 57.9% success rate. Kvaal covers the Consumer Goods sector, focusing on stocks such as CommScope Holding, Arista Networks, and Ciena Corp.
Apple has an analyst consensus of Moderate Buy, with a price target consensus of $183.75, which is a 18.8% upside from current levels. In a report issued on January 18, Longbow Research also maintained a Hold rating on the stock.
See today’s analyst top recommended stocks >>
The company has a one-year high of $233.47 and a one-year low of $142. Currently, Apple has an average volume of 43.17M.
Based on the recent corporate insider activity of 58 insiders, corporate insider sentiment is positive on the stock. This means that over the past quarter there has been an increase of insiders buying their shares of AAPL in relation to earlier this year. Earlier this month, Albert Gore, a Director at AAPL bought 35,000 shares for a total of $507,850.
